Only kill criminals whose reports are limited to national, forum and/or foreign. Mixes like clips+forum are OK because a trace of them reveals nothing beyond forum. Never kill anyone reported ONLY in clips, blotter or regional:South, since each trace like that cuts the pool by another 20-25%. Expected pool is about 100k x 0.55 x 0.25 x 0.25 = about 3400, which is safe. If a press conference shows the pool under about 5000, kill national-only criminals from then on.
